title: Rory and the Twilight Bluebell Hill
verses:
The twilight was falling across the wide hill,
The valley of bluebells was ready to sleep,
The breezes were whispering quiet and still,
While Rory stepped softly where shadows grew deep.

When Nia looked down from the darkening sky,
She guided the friends as the river moved slow,
The branches of cedar were waving up high,
Where blossoms of purple were starting to glow.

Then Benny walked down to the moss on the ground,
Where Tilly was brushing through ribbons of grass,
The night didn't carry a clatter or sound,
Except for the breeze as it happened to pass.

Now Ricky curled down in a velvety nest,
As Psittaco chirped to the silvering light,
Both tired and cozy and ready for rest,
Beneath the cool glow of the welcoming night.

Then Rory looked out at the blossoms of blue,
And gave a warm yawn for the friends who were near,
The petals were touched by the evening's cool dew,
And starlight was shining so tender and clear.

He tucked his green tail and he rested his head,
Where all of his friends fell in harmony deep,
The hill of sweet bluebells became their soft bed,
And Rory was drifting away into sleep.
